Assign.hint: Choose the voice preset used when you control this token or speak as it. Leave as inherit to use the actor's voice.

Bar.title: Voice
Bar.monitorTip: Self-monitor: hear your processed voice (use headphones; adds latency)
Bar.testTip: Test mic: open the microphone without A/V to audition voices

Editor.title: NPC Voice Preset Editor
Editor.name: Name
Editor.liveHint: Changes are previewed live on your outgoing mic. Save to keep them.
Editor.removePackConfirm: Remove this preset pack from the world? Actors using its voices fall back to Natural.
Editor.latency: Added latency for this voice: about {ms} ms.
Editor.layersHint: Parallel voices mixed with the main one (e.g. an octave-down double or a sub layer). Level 0 turns a layer off.

Keys.slotHint: Switch to the Nth voice on the quick bar.

Notify.monitorWarn: Self-monitor is on. Use headphones to avoid feedback; you will hear yourself with a small delay.
Notify.gmOnly: Only the GM can edit presets.

Err.notPack: Not an NPC Voice preset pack.
Err.notPresets: Not an NPC Voice preset or pack file.

enabled.name: Enable voice changer
enabled.hint: Route your microphone through the voice chain when Foundry A/V opens it (this client).

allowPlayers.name: Allow players
allowPlayers.hint: Let players use the voice changer too (GM only by default).

showBar.name: Show quick preset bar
showBar.hint: Show the voice bar with presets, bypass, meter and monitor.

autoSwitch.name: Switch voice on token control
autoSwitch.hint: When you control a token, switch to its voice.

switchOnChat.name: Switch voice on chat speaker
switchOnChat.hint: When you post a chat message as an actor or token, switch to its voice.

releaseNatural.name: Release to Natural
releaseNatural.hint: Return to the Natural voice when no token is controlled or the token has no voice.

disableProcessing.name: Disable browser voice processing while effects are on
disableProcessing.hint: Turns off echo cancellation, noise suppression and auto gain while a voice is active (they smear effects). Natural/bypass turns them back on.

notifySwitch.name: Notify on voice switch
notifySwitch.hint: Show a notification when the voice changes.
